channel.title: MiniFrontier V1 implementation backlog
channel.description: Dependency-ordered work items derived from plan.md. Detailed acceptance criteria are canonical in tasks/backlog.md.

item.title: [MF-001] Bootstrap the packaged Python project
item.description: Initialize the uv Python 3.12 package and selected PyTorch backend. Acceptance: sync/import succeeds, lockfiles exist, and reruns never overwrite files. Depends on: none.

item.title: [MF-002] Configure developer tooling and CI
item.description: Configure Ruff, pytest, policy, ignores, and CPU GitHub Actions. Acceptance: lint and fast tests pass locally and in CI. Depends on: MF-001.

item.title: [MF-003] Create the final package and command skeleton
item.description: Create the planned source, train, scripts, eval, labs, tests, configs, templates, and artifacts layout. Acceptance: modules import safely and stubs cannot silently succeed. Depends on: MF-001.

item.title: [MF-004] Implement and validate model configuration
item.description: Implement ModelConfig and frozen TOML presets. Acceptance: invalid head/window/position combinations fail and parameter targets are tested. Depends on: MF-003.

item.title: [MF-005] Define reproducibility and run metadata
item.description: Add deterministic seeding and run-record schema. Acceptance: code/config/dependency/hardware/token/timing/memory/loss metadata are captured. Depends on: MF-002, MF-004.

item.title: [MF-006] Freeze repository and data licensing policy
item.description: Select repository license and define provenance/no-secrets rules. Acceptance: public license is explicit and each dataset records source, revision, license, and hash. Depends on: MF-001.

item.title: [MF-007] Implement RMSNorm test-first
item.description: Implement explicit bias-free RMSNorm. Acceptance: shape/dtype/device and output/gradient reference parity pass. Depends on: MF-003, MF-004.

item.title: [MF-008] Implement SwiGLU test-first
item.description: Implement bias-free three-projection SwiGLU. Acceptance: output/gradient reference parity and dimensions pass. Depends on: MF-003, MF-004.

item.title: [MF-009] Implement causal and local mask helpers
item.description: Implement full causal and offset-aware sliding-window masks. Acceptance: future/out-of-window keys are blocked for prefill and decode. Depends on: MF-003, MF-004.

item.title: [MF-010] Implement manual scaled dot-product attention
item.description: Implement QK transpose, scaling, mask, softmax, and PV teaching path. Acceptance: hand values, masked probabilities, and finite backward pass. Depends on: MF-009.

item.title: [MF-011] Implement shifted language-model loss
item.description: Implement next-token CE and optional ignore/loss masks. Acceptance: shift direction and masked denominator edge cases pass. Depends on: MF-003.

item.title: [MF-012] Prove the primitives learn a tiny batch
item.description: Create deterministic CPU micro-model overfit proof. Acceptance: loss crosses a bounded threshold and gradients stay finite. Depends on: MF-007, MF-008, MF-010, MF-011.

item.title: [MF-013] Implement RoPE with external primitive parity
item.description: Implement cached RoPE with documented rotate-half convention. Acceptance: invariant/offset tests and trusted Transformers primitive parity pass. Depends on: MF-004.

item.title: [MF-014] Implement full causal MHA
item.description: Build bias-free Q/K/V/O projections, RoPE, and manual full causal MHA. Acceptance: shapes/head transforms/causality pass. Depends on: MF-007, MF-009, MF-010, MF-013.

item.title: [MF-015] Add the PyTorch SDPA execution path
item.description: Add optimized SDPA while retaining manual mode. Acceptance: full causal SDPA uses attn_mask=None/is_causal=True for fused-kernel eligibility; cache offsets are correct; explicit FP32 output/gradient parity passes. Depends on: MF-014.

item.title: [MF-016] Implement the pre-norm Transformer block
item.description: Implement readable residual attention and FFN block. Acceptance: ordering, shape, and dropout behavior are tested. Depends on: MF-007, MF-008, MF-015.

item.title: [MF-017] Implement the MiniFrontier language model
item.description: Assemble embedding, blocks, norm, tied head, depth-aware initialization, logits/loss. Acceptance: tying, shapes/counts/bounds pass; base std scales with width and residual outputs by 1/sqrt(2*n_layers); hot paths avoid validation .item() synchronizations. Depends on: MF-004, MF-016.

item.title: [MF-018] Complete Edu correctness and gradient tests
item.description: Add model causality, finite loss/backward, device/state, deterministic eval tests. Acceptance: clean fast CPU suite passes. Depends on: MF-017.

item.title: [MF-019] Prove Edu learning and validate 50M construction
item.description: Run a 100-example faithful reduced-config CPU overfit and instantiate frozen 50M Edu. Acceptance: loss reaches below 1e-3 nats/token, evidence persists, sample continues correctly, and 50M has exactly 53,361,152 trainable parameters. Depends on: MF-012, MF-018.

item.title: [MF-020] Freeze tokenizer contract and token IDs
item.description: Freeze 16K byte-BPE and all reserved special tokens. Acceptance: IDs, normalization, pre-tokenization, and boundaries are documented and immutable. Depends on: MF-004, MF-006.

item.title: [MF-021] Build the tokenizer training CLI
item.description: Build deterministic streaming byte-BPE trainer. Acceptance: stable special IDs and Unicode round trips. Depends on: MF-020.

item.title: [MF-022] Test tokenizer correctness and quality
item.description: Add round-trip, special, code, multilingual, and compression smoke tests. Acceptance: reserved tokens stay atomic and versioned fixture passes. Depends on: MF-021.

item.title: [MF-023] Define document and provenance schemas
item.description: Define normalized document and source manifest. Acceptance: source/revision/license/language/ID/split/hash required. Depends on: MF-006.

item.title: [MF-024] Implement streaming source adapters
item.description: Add bounded/resumable FineWeb-Edu and local-code manifest adapters. Acceptance: deterministic shuffle/resume without full download. Depends on: MF-023.

item.title: [MF-025] Filter, deduplicate, tokenize, split, and pack
item.description: Build fixed-length EOS-aware packed pipeline. Acceptance: no token loss/duplication/leakage and correct batch shapes. Depends on: MF-022, MF-024.

item.title: [MF-026] Build adversarial data-pipeline tests
item.description: Test empty/long/Unicode/duplicate/resume/short-pack/worker cases. Acceptance: deterministic network-free tests catch leakage and off-by-one errors. Depends on: MF-025.

item.title: [MF-027] Run the 50M Edu real-data smoke train
item.description: Run bounded full-50M real packed data integration on the CPU Dev Box. Acceptance: finite forward/backward, metrics, cache, and exact checkpoint reload without a quality claim. The 1-5M-token home-RTX continuation is tracked by MF-063. Depends on: MF-019, MF-026.

item.title: [MF-028] Design and implement the KVCache API
item.description: Implement per-layer B/KV/S/D cache invariants. Acceptance: append/reset/reuse/overflow tested and training is cache-free. Depends on: MF-014, MF-017.

item.title: [MF-029] Implement prefill and token-by-token decode
item.description: Implement offset-correct cached prefill/decode. Acceptance: cached/full logits agree across prompt/decode lengths and batches. Depends on: MF-028.

item.title: [MF-030] Implement robust sampling
item.description: Add greedy, temperature, top-k, top-p, per-row EOS, limits, seed. Acceptance: deterministic zero-temp and argument/batch edge tests. Depends on: MF-029.

item.title: [MF-031] Implement training checkpoint and exact resume
item.description: Save safetensors plus optimizer/scheduler/RNG/data/trainer/config state. Acceptance: tied logits survive and resumed fixture matches uninterrupted run. Depends on: MF-005, MF-017.

item.title: [MF-032] Implement published-model export/import
item.description: Export model/config/tokenizer/template/card release folder. Acceptance: fresh process reproduces logits and generation from folder only. Depends on: MF-021, MF-031.

item.title: [MF-033] Add sample and base-chat CLIs
item.description: Add prompt and interactive base-model entry points. Acceptance: help, stdin, seed/device/config, and safe errors pass. Depends on: MF-030, MF-032.

item.title: [MF-034] Implement language-model validation metrics
item.description: Implement CE, perplexity, BPB with weighted aggregation. Acceptance: hand fixtures and padding/partial/determinism tests pass. Depends on: MF-025, MF-031.

item.title: [MF-035] Build the lm-eval adapter and small suite
item.description: Adapt ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, PIQA, optional GSM8K. Acceptance: local smoke records harness version/settings and separates failures from scores. Depends on: MF-030, MF-032.

item.title: [MF-036] Version the coding/FIM evaluation fixtures
item.description: Create licensed/original completion, FIM, repair, and unit-test fixtures. Acceptance: contamination controls and scoring tests pass. Depends on: MF-006, MF-020.

item.title: [MF-037] Implement experiment and benchmark recording
item.description: Record quality, throughput, wall time, peak VRAM, inference, cache bytes. Acceptance: schema validation and matched-comparison guards pass. Depends on: MF-005, MF-034.

item.title: [MF-038] Publish the 50M Edu baseline scorecard
item.description: Publish baseline quality/efficiency with hardware and limits. Acceptance: raw records linked and no unsupported claim. Depends on: MF-027, MF-034, MF-035, MF-037.

item.title: [MF-039] Implement GQA without hidden K/V expansion
item.description: Add configurable Q/KV heads and native SDPA GQA. Acceptance: manual reference expands K/V; optimized full attention uses enable_gqa=True without Python K/V repetition; output/gradient parity, fused-causal prefill, shapes, and parameter/cache savings pass. Depends on: MF-015, MF-028.

item.title: [MF-040] Add optional QK-Norm
item.description: Normalize Q/K per head before RoPE. Acceptance: Edu off, Modern on, ordering/gradient/disabled parity tests pass. Depends on: MF-007, MF-039.

item.title: [MF-041] Implement the 3-local/1-global schedule
item.description: Implement Local/Local/Local/Global with FlexAttention and native GQA. Acceptance: exact-window manual/Flex parity, arbitrary layer counts, cached/compiled block masks, explicit fallback, and no out-of-window or unwritten reads. M4 uses a full-history local cache as its correctness reference; bounded storage and memory claims belong to MF-050. Depends on: MF-009, MF-039.

item.title: [MF-042] Add the global NoPE experiment flag
item.description: Add rope/none for global layers while local keeps RoPE. Acceptance: RoPE default, exact selection, cached/full parity, long-context finiteness/magnitude reporting, and no silently coupled temperature tuning or logit cap. Depends on: MF-013, MF-041.

item.title: [MF-043] Complete Modern correctness/cache tests
item.description: Test GQA/local/global/QK/NoPE and the full-history local-cache reference. Acceptance: FP32 manual/optimized and cached/full parity for prefill/token/chunks, exact per-position argmax, safe truncation, and no out-of-window/unwritten reads. BF16 belongs to MF-046; bounded cache to MF-050. Depends on: MF-040, MF-041, MF-042.

item.title: [MF-044] Overfit and compare 50M Modern
item.description: Run matched CPU 50M Edu/Modern correctness and scorecard. Acceptance: tiny overfit and controlled tokenizer/data/token/batch/context comparison report parameter/cache differences without speed claims; 8K+ GPU hybrid efficiency, allocated/logical cache bytes, and decode throughput belong to MF-050. Depends on: MF-038, MF-043.

item.title: [MF-045] Implement the canonical AdamW training loop
item.description: Implement explicit AdamW/warmup/cosine/global-clip/token loop over bounded providers. Acceptance: groups/cadence/LR/accounting are tested; scheduler progress is explicit in optimizer updates or non-padding tokens, checkpointed, and boundary-tested; all-masked batches are rejected; token dtype/range is checked on CPU before CUDA transfer; tensor assertions and metric .item() stay outside layer/token/microbatch hot paths; production sharding remains MF-047. Depends on: MF-027, MF-031.

item.title: [MF-046] Add BF16 autocast and gradient accumulation
item.description: Add gated BF16 for training/cached inference, exact accumulation, CLI precision selection, and mixed-precision cache contract. Acceptance: CPU fallback and split/unsplit parity; cache is allocated from projected K/V dtype, sample/chat/eval share auto|float32|bfloat16, and CPU/CUDA full-cache numerical plus argmax parity use fixed tolerances. Depends on: MF-045.

item.title: [MF-047] Make streaming training exactly resumable
item.description: Build bounded-memory immutable hashed memory-mappable token/count shards, Windows-spawn-safe loading, deterministic shard/row shuffle, exact data-order state, and crash-safe publication. Acceptance: prepare_data streams pinned FineWeb-Edu revision 87f09149ef4734204d70ed1d046ddc9ca3f2b8f9 directly; versioned exact/near dedup and evaluation exclusion precede split; separate atomic NPY arrays are cached as one memory map per worker; no whole-corpus list/live worker generator; seed/policy/epoch/shard/row state resumes exactly and mismatches fail closed. CUDA fused runs record determinism and use a fixed tolerance. Depends on: MF-024, MF-025, MF-031, MF-046.

item.title: [MF-048] Add optional torch.compile
item.description: Add post-correctness compile switch and path-specific diagnostics. Acceptance: eager default and output parity; training/prefill and mutation-heavy decode graph breaks are reported separately, and EOS/dynamic-shape/cache failures have actionable fallback or errors. Depends on: MF-043, MF-046.

item.title: [MF-049] Add activation checkpointing by block
item.description: Add optional whole-block checkpointing. Acceptance: loss/gradient parity and speed/memory benchmark. Depends on: MF-046.

item.title: [MF-050] Profile and tune the 24-32 GB GPU path
item.description: Harden and profile the single-stream 24-32GB GPU path. Acceptance: last-token prefill logits, non-quadratic output storage, finite/hand-tested top-k/top-p sampling, and optional bounded local ring cache exactly match the full-history reference across chunks/rollback and single-token decoding beyond two window wraps. CUDA records separate failures plus graph breaks, selected kernel/backend, determinism, precision/cache dtype, VRAM, TTFT, prefill/inter-token/decode throughput, cache bytes, and ring rollback allocation traffic before safeguards are changed. The 8K+ hybrid run uses a labeled performance-only context/window override with unchanged weights and no quality claim. FlexAttention is required; first-party varlen sliding GQA may be parity-profiled optionally. No concurrency claim. Depends on: MF-037, MF-046, MF-047, MF-048, MF-049.

item.title: [MF-051] Implement licensed code-corpus ingestion
item.description: Ingest and sanitize approved manifest-driven permissive/public-domain code. Acceptance: full provenance/pipeline version retained; licensing enforced; reviewed secret/credential, PII-policy, malformed/binary/generated/vendor/minified, and exact/near-eval-contamination filters emit aggregate reason counts without rejected sensitive text. Depends on: MF-023, MF-024, MF-036.

item.title: [MF-052] Implement deterministic FIM transforms and mixing
item.description: Add prefix/suffix/middle transform and configured mix. Acceptance: reconstruction, boundaries, short samples, seed, 10-20 percent range. Depends on: MF-020, MF-025, MF-051.

item.title: [MF-053] Run matched normal-versus-FIM code training
item.description: Run controlled normal/FIM 50M pair. Acceptance: only mixture changes and budgets/seeds/checkpoints/raw metrics are retained; bounded CPU pair proves integration without effect claims, while coding-quality conclusions require MF-063 home-GPU evidence. Depends on: MF-044, MF-045, MF-047, MF-052.

item.title: [MF-054] Score and report coding/FIM effects
item.description: Report syntax/compile/tests/FIM exact/functional and LM regressions. Acceptance: scorer/report is exercised on versioned fixtures and includes exact/near contamination, variance/limits and raw links; CPU results are engineering-only and effect claims wait for MF-063 GPU evidence. Depends on: MF-036, MF-053.

item.title: [MF-055] Write the educational Muon reference
item.description: Write annotated non-production Newton-Schulz/Muon lab. Acceptance: tiny matrix tests and impossible accidental production selection. Depends on: MF-007, MF-005.

item.title: [MF-056] Integrate first-party Muon with AdamW partitioning
item.description: Muon eligible 2-D hidden matrices; AdamW all others. Acceptance: every parameter exactly once and partition/adjustment tested/reported. Depends on: MF-045, MF-055.

item.title: [MF-057] Run a fair AdamW-versus-Muon experiment
item.description: Run matched-token A/B plus separate LR sweep per arm. Acceptance: choices/loss/throughput reported without an unfair shared LR claim. The bounded CPU record is engineering evidence; post-M10 RTX owns VRAM/variance/scale conclusions. Depends on: MF-037, MF-056.

item.title: [MF-058] Implement and test the chat template
item.description: Implement a simple system/user/assistant Jinja template and concise default general/coding system prompt. Acceptance: deterministic roles/EOS, invalid ordering rejection, token-contract parity across Jinja/runtime/SFT serialization for multi-turn and generation prompts, a short capability-honest optional prompt, and no hidden/tool protocol. Depends on: MF-020, MF-032.

item.title: [MF-059] Build SFT examples and assistant-only loss masks
item.description: Build conversation packing/truncation and assistant masks. Acceptance: only assistant spans contribute; multi-turn/truncation tests pass. Depends on: MF-011, MF-025, MF-058.

item.title: [MF-060] Implement the small SFT loop
item.description: Reuse raw training/checkpoint infrastructure for SFT. Acceptance: tiny overfit; deterministic epoch shuffle; exact resume validates shuffle seed/policy, epoch, cursor and batch count; base lineage and subset metadata are captured. Depends on: MF-045, MF-047, MF-059.

item.title: [MF-061] Evaluate instruction following and regressions
item.description: Compare base/SFT on fixed prompts and LM/code metrics. Acceptance: formatting/instruction behavior, refusal/unknown handling, held-out functional code, and language/code regressions use versioned original or license-reviewed fixtures with contamination status and fixed seeds; no broad quality claim comes from the tiny suite. Depends on: MF-034, MF-054, MF-060.

item.title: [MF-062] Complete the interactive chat path
item.description: Add a template-aware bounded-context multi-turn CLI. Acceptance: truncation preserves message/template boundaries; EOS, device, precision, seed, and finite sampling controls work; the release/default system prompt can be used, overridden or disabled; single-user non-server scope is documented; CPU smoke passes. Depends on: MF-030, MF-033, MF-058, MF-060.

item.title: [MF-063] Freeze the canonical training protocol and budget
item.description: Complete the user-scheduled post-M10 RTX 50M evidence, then freeze the 150M protocol. Acceptance: pinned 1-5M-token evidence includes loss/validation, CUDA dtype/cache parity, last-token prefill, BF16 cached generation, bounded-local-cache parity, TTFT/inter-token latency, compile/backend/determinism, throughput/VRAM, exact data/control resume plus tolerance-scoped numerical resume, cached samples, eval and FIM follow-up; failures stay separate. Validated draft/frozen protocol tooling fails closed without evidence hashes. If books/PDFs enter the mixture, a clean adapter fails closed on training/release rights, strips RAG overlap/boilerplate, splits whole books by PDF hash, records extraction provenance, excludes Gemini-derived text absent explicit approval, and keeps the external AGPL converter/raw books out of MiniFrontier. Depends on: MF-054, MF-057, MF-061.

item.title: [MF-064] Train MiniFrontier-150M-Edu
item.description: Train canonical Edu under approved protocol. Acceptance: budget completes stably; best/final/resume state and metadata retained. Depends on: MF-063.

item.title: [MF-065] Train MiniFrontier-150M-Modern
item.description: Train canonical Modern under matched protocol. Acceptance: same tokenizer/data order/budget/batch/context/eval except architecture settings. Depends on: MF-063.

item.title: [MF-066] Produce the canonical teaching comparison
item.description: Compare Edu/Modern quality, throughput, VRAM, params and cache under docs/EVALUATION_RELEASE_GATE.md. Acceptance: validation plus historical, reasoning/knowledge, instruction/chat, functional code/FIM and trained-context retrieval tiers record exact revisions/prompts, contamination, isolated-code policy, failures and not-run states; ARC-Easy/HellaSwag/PIQA alone cannot support chat/coding claims; strong causal claims use 3+ seeds or are exploratory. Depends on: MF-064, MF-065.

item.title: [MF-067] Export release artifacts and model cards
item.description: Export load-tested weights, model/generation configs, tokenizer, chat template/default system prompt, cards, SHA-256 manifest, and results. Acceptance: fresh deterministic generation; generation metadata records special IDs/context/conservative defaults; every artifact is hashed; cards document precision/device and fixed-shape educational inference limits without untested external-runtime claims. Depends on: MF-032, MF-066.

item.title: [MF-068] Cut the GitHub-ready V1 release
item.description: Tag repo with README/release notes/CI/repro commands/archive. Acceptance: CPU Actions/home-GPU smoke and clean clone pass; RESEARCH_SOURCE_REVIEW is current; each bundled paper/archive has a redistribution decision/notice; scripts/build_source_archive.py includes .github/workflows/ci.yml, rejects unintended large files, and excludes pycache/pyc, secrets, local paths, corpora/checkpoints/caches, duplicate third-party trees and bundled research/reference archives; no open P0/P1. Depends on: MF-002, MF-006, MF-067.

item.title: [MF-069] Implement and preflight the optional scale-check harness
item.description: Implement validated 350M/500M accounting, OOM-safe preflight commands, report schema, stop criteria and CPU/meta dry runs. Acceptance: estimates are labeled; construction, validation, checkpoint/resume wiring and serialization pass on bounded paths; CUDA fields stay unmeasured and no scale decision or quality claim is fabricated. Depends on: MF-045, MF-047, MF-048.

item.title: [MF-070] Run the 350M scale check and decide whether to attempt 500M
item.description: Measure 350M Modern and decide whether to run a bounded 500M stretch. Acceptance: real GPU VRAM/throughput/time/cost/checkpointing/learning behavior/value/stop criteria and failures are documented; V1 artifacts remain unchanged. Depends on: MF-068, MF-069.

item.title: [MF-071] Export a Transformers-compatible Hugging Face repository
item.description: Create separate Hub-ready Edu/Modern exports with MiniFrontier PretrainedConfig/base/causal-LM classes, tokenizer integration, safe weights, generation config, cards, architectures and auto_map while keeping the core raw PyTorch. Acceptance: clean pinned AutoConfig/AutoModel/AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer loads from local and pinned Hub revisions; native/Transformers logits and greedy tokens match for Edu/Modern including GQA, QK-Norm, hybrid and NoPE; tied weights, special/FIM/chat IDs, chat template/default system prompt, context, dtype, hashes, license and revision are preserved. Hosting alone is not compatibility. Depends on: MF-067.

item.title: [MF-072] Validate MiniFrontier with vLLM on Windows-hosted NVIDIA CUDA
item.description: Target vLLM's Transformers modeling backend first and use an out-of-tree plugin only if required; document Windows 11 + WSL2. Acceptance: custom-model contract is met; both presets load through vllm serve from a pinned Hub revision under WSL2 CUDA; prompt logprobs/greedy continuation match native reference across prefill/decode and Modern flags; OpenAI API, BF16/cache, version, VRAM, TTFT and decode throughput are recorded; pinned text-only/tool-disabled smokes cover Vercel AI SDK generateText/streamText/messages/application loops plus OpenCode, Cline, Roo Code, Kilo Code and Aider with the real context limit, separately from code-edit quality. Do not claim V1 tool calling or native Win32 vLLM. Depends on: MF-050, MF-071.

item.title: [MF-073] Add high-precision GGUF and llama.cpp architecture support
item.description: Implement a pinned upstream patch or adapter for MiniFrontier GGUF conversion, tensor/tokenizer metadata, loading and compute graph. Acceptance: BF16/F16 conversion preserves Edu/Modern RoPE, GQA, QK-Norm, local/global schedule, NoPE, tied embeddings, special IDs and windows; no false llama architecture label; llama-cli/server pass native-reference parity and native Windows 11 NVIDIA-CUDA smoke before quantization; revisions/hashes are pinned. Depends on: MF-071.

item.title: [MF-074] Quantize, evaluate, and publish the 4-bit GGUF artifacts
item.description: Create reproducible Q4_K_M Edu/Modern GGUF repositories from BF16/F16 GGUF. Acceptance: importance-matrix/calibration use is explicit with pinned licensed data, sampling/tokenizer recipe, hashes and evaluation-contamination checks, retaining an uncalibrated comparison where needed; native Windows 11 CUDA CLI/server load; record size, RAM/VRAM, prompt/decode throughput, perplexity/validation delta, greedy changes, LM/code regressions, tokenizer/template behavior, quantizer command/version, source revision and SHA-256 hashes. Loadability alone is insufficient. Depends on: MF-038, MF-066, MF-073.
